entries.summary: Retain unchanged: borrowed provider context routes timestamp errors, borrowed snapshots and optional explicit artifact collection. The port allocates and retains nothing; snapshot does not invoke collection.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: synchronous prepared transfer borrows its payload, forwards original errors/reports, and delegates prewarm and instance upload policy. Provider adapter owns the direct-write conversion; this port has no second execution interpreter.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: Vulkan supplies immutable stage identity and a typed artifact-state owner to the shared explicit fallible writer. No borrowed pending-field convention or telemetry-triggered filesystem work remains.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Examined the entire command adapter, promoted compute boundary, upload/write/capture paths and receipt construction. Checked write sizing now precedes lazy device/resource acquisition; broader accounting and dispatch policy remain unresolved.
findings: execute_buffer_write_bytes includes flush time in write_ns/setup_ns and again in submit_wait_ns; deferred recording can report a submission without committing. execute_upload/execute_barrier infer submission count from elapsed duration. Move counts to actual queue submission events and split timing scopes.

execute_dispatch_command selects the no-op program only when no pipeline is active. Establish and test the dispatch contract after an explicit kernel command; the current active-pipeline shortcut can retain unrelated program state.

use_explicit_submit_boundaries is a constant-false experimental branch with several inactive alternatives; remove only after preserving recorded submission behavior and accounting in direct/repeated/indirect characterization tests.
resolvedFindings: Checked offset plus byte count rejects overflow and empty input before resource acquisition; boundary tests exercise overflow and declared/minimum capacity.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined provider-owned configuration, lazy runtime construction, capability routing, snapshot borrowing and explicit artifact capture/collection. Artifact ownership is stronger; unsupported configuration and capability admission remain open.
findings: set_webgpu_ffi_queue_wait_timeout_ns discards both inputs. Instance timeout semantics need a Vulkan completion owner and timeout retention tests; accepting the setter does not establish bounded waits.
capability_set enables async diagnostic families whose strict implementations do not execute their named semantic features; reconcile capability admission with real probe behavior.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: one temporary instance selects a physical device and captures descriptor identity, capabilities and queue metadata before explicit teardown. Identity disagreement tests cover all compared fields. The identity is a device descriptor, not proof of a unique physical board or feature correctness.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Examined strict/emulated diagnostics and returned operation counts; the explicit feature-policy branch is visible but several named probes do not establish the semantics they advertise.
findings: execute .capability_introspection only reads cached values into discarded expressions; its duration and iterations are not evidence of asynchronous callback work or GPU dispatch.

Strict resource-table/immediates and pixel-local-storage routes delegate to resource construction/upload or empty subpasses. Require real feature-specific operations and independent outputs; distinguish logical iteration counts from actual GPU submissions.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined temporary buffers/images, render-pass construction, submissions, native waits and cleanup. Format failure now propagates; lifetime and strict feature meaning remain unresolved.
findings: resource_table_immediates_probe and pixel_local_storage_probe defer destruction of submitted buffers/images/framebuffers after finite wait errors. A timeout is not terminal completion; transfer temporaries to an explicit pending owner before submission.

pixel_local_storage_probe builds an input-attachment subpass without corresponding input-attachment image usage, uses conflicting input/color layouts for the same attachment, and executes no shader. Correct native admission and execute an independent pixel-local-storage oracle before claiming strict support.
resolvedFindings: Removed the format-error-to-RGBA8 replacement; the requested format now either maps explicitly or returns its original error.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: ABI-only extern feature/property structures have no ownership or runtime policy. Independent comparison against installed Khronos headers verifies every exported struct size, alignment, field offset and field size.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Examined command-pool ownership, reuse indexing, replay begin and indirect mapped writes. Allocation publication and write capacity are repaired; the shared indirect argument lifetime still needs its caller fixed.
findings: NativeVulkanRuntime.run_dispatch_indirect writes the shared argument buffer before flushing prior deferred uses (and can defer that flush). Retire the prior use before modifying host bytes, with consecutive differently-sized deferred dispatches and timeout tests.
resolvedFindings: Reserve host list capacity before vkAllocateCommandBuffers so host OOM cannot leave a native command untracked; fail-before-native regression passes.
Reject an indirect buffer smaller than the argument payload before memcpy; sentinels and exact-size writes are tested.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined detached compute-cache ownership and begin/finish/submit/deinit transitions, including recorded descriptor validation. Submission success fixtures do not cover failed retirement.
findings: ComputeProgram.deinit suppresses flush_queue failure and destroys command pools and owned compute state. Unknown completion can therefore free GPU-live objects. Introduce a fallible close/deferred owner and prove timeout, retry, device failure and teardown ordering.
begin/finish temporarily move active runtime cache state; incomplete begin and wrong-device destruction need explicit failure/lifetime tests binding the caller cleanup contract.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Compute/transfer visibility remains owned here. Buffer access tracking is bounded and falls back conservatively on incomplete tracking; storage-image writes retain global hazards. The repaired indirect boundary no longer consumes shader visibility obligations.
resolvedFindings: Indirect-only barriers preserve pending shader hazards, for both exact-buffer and unknown/global tracking; recording tests verify masks and a later shader consumer still requires visibility.
Incomplete current-binding tracking now forces visibility rather than relying on the truncated handle intersection.
Global transfer/compute barriers cover shader plus indirect consumption before clearing their shared tracking state; removed the obsolete pending-buffer-removal helper.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: Vulkan ABI constants and aliases remain in the backend binding owner. Independent header comparison checks exported matching numeric Vulkan declarations; native calls and behavioral policy remain with consumers.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: exact descriptor snapshots combine declaration, generation, backing handles, extent and layout. Checked generation exhaustion fails instead of wrapping. Parent-generation checks reject recycled images; collision resolution consumes full snapshots, not hash equality.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Examined descriptor scratch allocation, resource resolution, identity binding, cache restore and native pool ownership. Empty whole-buffer tails are rejected; texture semantics and promotion during recording remain open.
findings: validate_texture_binding accepts enumerated sample types without checking the actual format/sample-type compatibility. Validate descriptor format semantics before native descriptor updates.

prepare can promote or change texture layout while replay recording is active. Trace replacement/retired-source destruction and command-pool reset against already recorded commands; add growth/promotion and failed-wait fixtures before claiming retained lifetime completeness.
resolvedFindings: Whole-size range validation now rejects offset equal to buffer size; tests cover empty tail, valid last byte and overflowing explicit range.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined instance/device bootstrap, queue selection, queried feature enablement, lazy submission state, extension lookup and memory selection. Native ownership flags support teardown, but retry and capability details remain incomplete.
findings: create_command_pool_and_primary_buffer sets has_command_pool before allocating the primary buffer; ensure_submission_state checks only the pool flag, so retry after allocation failure can proceed without a primary buffer. Make lazy submission initialization transactional or check both owned components.

score_physical_device sums heap size once per memory type, double-counting shared heaps; present_capable_value is inferred from graphics support without surface support query. Keep physical observations separate from selection heuristics.
Depth-clip extension presence is used as enabled support without querying/enabling its feature struct. Bind extension feature admission to pipeline state before using unclipped depth.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined physical limit/format queries and public feature conversion. The current minimum-floor mapping can overstate native capabilities and needs repair with adapter/device admission tests.
findings: map_vulkan_to_wgpu_limits applies max(native, WebGPU minimum) to native maxima and clamp_alignment can lower a required hardware alignment. Advertise only supported limits and reject adapters/devices that cannot meet required minima.

maxComputeWorkgroupsPerDimension examines only the X dimension; use the common bound across axes. Dynamic buffer counts and several other fields are fixed constants rather than queried/validated limits.

has_feature returns Depth32FloatStencil8 unconditionally and depth-clip support follows extension presence alone. Query required format/feature support; probe_device_caps substitutes 36 timestamp bits instead of retaining the selected value.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined prepared indirect replay through transfer visibility, indirect visibility, conservative replay barrier and pipeline/descriptors. It borrows native resources and relies on external admission.
findings: record_prepared_replay receives a raw buffer and offset but no capacity/device proof. Bind each caller admission of alignment, argument footprint, generation and pending lifetime; add rejection/early-release coverage before declaring this boundary complete.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined dependent versus independent repeated recording, query boundaries, synchronous submission and returned metrics. Batch ownership is not safely recoverable from every wait failure.
findings: run_batch submits the primary command with a finite wait but does not register pending ownership before that wait. A failed wait must prevent resetting/reusing that command and its resources.

queue_wait_mode is ignored for batches larger than one. Timestamp subtraction checks ordered endpoints but does not apply selected queue timestampValidBits; test rollover and required-mode rejection before execution.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined feature pNext chains, format tables, subgroup/f16 constraints and enabled-device feature construction. Query output and enabled implementation need a stronger correspondence.
findings: Texture tier support is derived from format properties while enabled_core_features leaves shaderStorageImageExtendedFormats disabled. Bind advertised tier operations to the native features and compiler paths actually enabled.

Format tables duplicate native format identities and tier policy rather than deriving the semantic set from an authoritative contract; extend capability tests to all advertised tier operations before claiming complete support.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: temporary feature-probe instance is allocator-scoped and destroyed on every exit after creation; selected-device query delegates to the feature owner. This wrapper neither caches global state nor independently guarantees every advertised feature.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: backend format translation owns native enum mapping while canonical contracts own byte/block footprints and vertex identities. Unknown texture formats explicitly fail; vertex switching is exhaustive. Independent header comparison verifies numeric format codes.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: narrow C-call declarations carry explicit native pointer/count/handle types and delegate VkResult taxonomy. No allocator, global state or execution fallback is hidden in this adapter; exercised native suites and ABI comparisons support the declared boundary.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: pure first-supported memory selection requires all mandatory flags and treats preferred flags only as preference; readback choices come from immutable build options. Coherence/type-mask regressions cover fallback and explicit unsupported results.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Retain unchanged: exact alias of the canonical dispatch metrics contract; no competing field registry, allocation, error translation or backend-specific interpretation is introduced.
entries.nextAction: Retain this responsibility; revalidate when the bound inputs change.

entries.summary: Examined shared pipeline identity, resource layout creation, active/cache/retired ownership, artifact snapshots and native binding. Explicit ownership exists but fallible retirement and configuration still need repair.
findings: retire_pipeline_objects/retire_descriptor_state panic on allocator failure rather than preserving a fallible transition; descriptor cache release during recorded work also needs a retained-owner proof.

required_subgroup_size_for_pipeline reads DOE_VULKAN_REQUIRED_SUBGROUP_SIZE per pipeline, accepts arbitrary parsed values and turns malformed input into null. Resolve validated instance policy once and bind it to pipeline identity.

SPIR-V admission uses local partial scans and only checks descriptor presence when no bindings are supplied. Validate requested entrypoint/stage and full binding layout with compiler metadata before native creation.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined exact-identity collision resolution, hot/map tiers, move-and-clear ownership, allocation rollback and buffer-specific invalidation. Cache capacity remains an undeclared unbounded resource cost.
findings: cached_compute_states and current_descriptor_state_cache grow without an overall capacity or full-capacity policy after fixed hot tiers fill. Declare retention behavior with pending-work-safe eviction/overflow and measure it; hot array size alone is not the cache limit.
Capture/restore APIs copy owning states and require paired clearing; preserve current callers but constrain move transitions and exercise teardown/idempotence before broad reuse.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined per-provider cache handle, paths, warmup observations, disk input and publication. Native handles are provider-owned, but shared storage paths and accepted blob meaning remain unresolved.
findings: Every provider uses the same .tmp path for a cache destination; concurrent flushes can truncate, rename or delete another writer staging file. Use unique temporary-file ownership and atomic replacement.

Reloaded state means bytes were read, not that the driver accepted compatible cache content. Header/provenance validation and malformed-file tests are missing; wall-clock subtraction can also underflow warmup duration.
An invalid/oversized explicit directory silently becomes empty and can select an environment path. Resolve declared configuration errors explicitly instead of changing destination.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined attachment selection, render-pass/pipeline ownership, direct/indexed/indirect encoding, surface synchronization, submission and bundle replay. Consequential lifetime and failure-propagation defects remain.
findings: record_indexed_draws destroys its temporary index buffer on return, before record_and_submit_draws submits the commands. Give inline index storage a submission-lifetime owner and test independent indexed output.
execute_render_draw/clear/bundles defer release_render_state even when native wait fails; retain command and attachment/pipeline resources until terminal completion.
Bundle replay errors are logged then skipped, allowing partial work to return success. Propagate failure before submission and ensure all encoded references remain owned.

Draw path lacks the clear path surface acquire/signal synchronization; vkCmdResetQueryPool is recorded inside a render pass; attachment extent/usage/sample admission and indirect/index ranges are incomplete. Validate before encoding and run validation-layer/output fixtures.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined graphics shader selection, entrypoint ownership, state conversion, vertex layouts and descriptor materialization. Exact entrypoint names and zero write masks are repaired; full graphics admission remains incomplete.
findings: createRenderDescriptorState trusts counts against fixed arrays, assumes one descriptor set, does not reject duplicate binding numbers, and emits missing texture/sampler handles as null. Validate complete layout and resource ranges before acquisition.

create_graphics_pipeline clamps oversized strides/offsets and truncates vertex-layout arrays; unsupported unclipped depth logs a fallback that changes behavior. Reject invalid inputs and bind enabled device features.

Several enum conversions silently choose defaults for unknown values; multisample pipeline state can disagree with the single-sampled render-pass/target owner. Canonical admission must establish these invariants.
resolvedFindings: Allocator-owned sentinel entrypoint strings preserve names beyond the former stack-buffer limit; empty/NUL names fail, and allocation failure propagates.
Zero color-write mask now preserves no-write semantics rather than becoming all channels; changed regressions replace the old fallback/truncation expectations.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined buffer allocation/growth/promotion, mapped and staged writes, capture, texture/view ownership and transitions. Existing generations and capacity reservation are useful; retained contents and admitted layouts need repairs.
findings: ensure_compute_buffer growth allocates a replacement and frees the previous buffer without preserving bytes; define growth versus object replacement and test existing contents across a partial write.
create_texture_view subtracts unchecked base mip from mip count and defaults array-layer count without subtracting base layer. Validate subresource bounds and native-compatible view descriptors.
bytes_per_pixel_for_texture_format converts unknown layout to four bytes. Preserve unsupported layout errors through footprint consumers.

Capture/promotion temporary resources are released on failed native wait, and texture layout transitions reset a shared command pool without fully accounting for active recordings. Bind all pending uses to the queue owner before recycling.

buffer_write_staging_offset plus length is unchecked; staging replacement can reset the runtime offset while callers retain the previous offset. Test checked growth, queued copies and subsequent writes.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.

entries.summary: Examined lifecycle, nominal async compilation, explicit emulation workloads and cached adapter access. Allocator/source cleanup is explicit, but diagnostic names do not establish their advertised semantics.
findings: pipeline_async_probe performs synchronous rebuilds; resource-table and pixel-local-storage emulation only allocate/upload/barrier with fixed byte counts. Define and execute equivalent semantic probes with independent outputs or expose explicit unsupported feature results.
Cached present_capable forwards graphics-queue inference from vk_device, not a queried surface capability; preserve that distinction in the observation contract.
entries.nextAction: Resolve the named findings with owner-specific failure and integration tests before verification.
